problem.heading: Search changed. Most businesses haven't noticed.
problem.body:
People used to scroll ten blue links. Now they ask an AI and get three or four names back. If you're not one of them, you never get the call, even with great reviews.

The AI picks the businesses it sees talked about across the web: news, articles, podcasts, video. That's what we build for you.

items.q: Do I have to write anything?
items.a: No. A short call to start, then a quick approval each month.  We write, produce and publish everything.

items.q: Is this the same as SEO?
items.a: Our goal is creating content that gets you ranked in AI, The answered questions in the content and inbound links are a factor in SEO as well as AI visibility. This is how AI assistants and Search engines decide who to recommend so you will see results in both.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: Content is created and goes live in the first 2-3 weeks. How you rank depends on a few factors, including competition and your brands current authority. AI answers update over time, so we check every month and show you how much traffic you are getting.

items.q: Is the content written by AI?
items.a: We use AI to sharpen and speed up the work, but it's 100% driven by real human experience: your story, your expertise, reviewed by people.
